description: This file contains the implementation of the PHPMailer SMTP transport class, providing methods to connect to SMTP servers, handle SMTP commands, perform authentication, and manage email transmission over SMTP protocol.

classes.name: PHPMailer\\PHPMailer\SMTP
classes.description: Class implementing SMTP connection management, command handling, and email transmission routines, supporting RFC compliance, debugging, and extension parsing.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to an SMTP server with optional hostname, port, timeout, and context options.

methods.name: startTLS
methods.description: Initiates a TLS encryption layer for secure communication with the SMTP server.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs SMTP authentication using specified username, password, and authentication method.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the SMTP server and checks for expected response codes.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the SMTP connection and resets internal state.
